Checkerboard comparison of two registered volumes

Source: R/plot-checkerboard.R
plot_checkerboard.Rd

Alternates tiles from a background volume and a comparison volume on matched slices. This is useful for visual registration QC.

Usage

plot_checkerboard(
  bgvol,
  overlay,
  zlevels = NULL,
  along = 3L,
  tile = 16L,
  cmap = "grays",
  bg_range = c("robust", "data"),
  ov_range = c("robust", "data"),
  probs = c(0.02, 0.98),
  ncol = 3L,
  title = NULL,
  subtitle = NULL,
  caption = NULL,
  draw = TRUE,
  style = c("light", "dark")
)

Arguments

bgvol

Background/reference 3D volume.

overlay

Comparison 3D volume on the same NeuroSpace grid as `bgvol`.

zlevels

Slices to plot. Defaults to nine evenly spaced slices.

along

Axis for slicing (1 sagittal, 2 coronal, 3 axial).

tile

Tile width in slice pixels.

cmap

Palette used to render the normalized checkerboard image.

bg_range, ov_range

"robust" or "data" intensity scaling.

probs

Quantiles for robust scaling.

ncol

Number of columns in the facet layout.

title, subtitle, caption

Optional layout-level labels used when drawing.

draw

Logical; if `TRUE`, draw the panels on the active graphics device. If `FALSE`, only return the ggplot objects invisibly.

style

Visual style, either "light" or "dark".
